info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Creditcard Applications Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Status API allows users to check the status of their credit card applications seamlessly. By leveraging this API, financial institutions can provide real-time updates regarding application progress, enhancing customer experience. It serves as a critical resource for customer service representatives and application processors to track and manage application statuses effectively. Typical use cases include responding to customer inquiries and monitoring application lifecycle events.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of applications. The response will provide insights into the status of each application, enabling users to monitor their progress or detect issues.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of applications. This should contain details about the specific applications for which the status is being queried.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the application status is returned.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusRequest.description: A JSON string that represents the request body for the application status operation.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.title: Application Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

ListCreditcardApplicationsStatusResponse.description: Schema representing the response structure for the Application Status GET operation. It includes the status of the operation, reference number, result ID, state, processing time, message, and audit information.
